# License map

## Font software

The extracted and packaged glyph geometry, font-reference payload, fixtures
that reproduce reusable glyph outlines, and packed outline streams are Font
Software under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 in `LICENSE-OFL.md`.

Redistributed copies must retain the Adobe copyright notice and complete OFL.
Further font derivatives must remain under the OFL and must respect the
Reserved Font Name `Source`.

## Inshell integration material

The package name, manifest conventions, JavaScript renderer, verifier,
extraction/build scripts, Solidity decoder, documentation, and gallery
presentation are private Inshell integration material. No public license grant
is supplied for those components; see `UNLICENSED.md`.

The package is therefore marked `private` and uses
`SEE LICENSE IN LICENSES.md` rather than treating every bundled file as if it
had one license.
